subject: WATER TANKS

items.label: Relief device rating verified against MAWP; discharge routed safely
items.note: Applies to pressure-rated tanks. An atmospheric tank answers NR here rather than needing its own template.

items.label: High-level / overflow alarm proven where fitted
items.convergence_reason: FIRM PRACTICE — fifty years of Isotherm field practice, cited as the anchor because the code set is silent here. Not dressed as a standard.

items.label: Low-level cutout proven where a pump draws from the tank
items.convergence_reason: FIRM PRACTICE — fifty years of Isotherm field practice, cited as the anchor because the code set is silent here. Not dressed as a standard. Running a pump dry is the failure this protects against, and it is the failure the corpus never checks for.
